brief.title: Open a dossier with a numbered question queue
brief.plain_summary: Turn a topic people will keep relying on into a first dossier version: its scope, a numbered queue of questions a source could answer, and the role of the person who decides what is published.
brief.outcome: A dossier in questions mode, or no_change with a pointer when one cited answer is enough.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

required: Write three to seven opening questions numbered from 1, each one a source could answer, framed like the research question template.

acceptance_checks.check: The refresh record validates against template.refresh-record's schema.
The listed facts are exactly those whose refresh_by is before checked_on.
Every still_true fact's new_refresh_by follows from new_as_of and its decay class.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Verify the pin, and list exactly the facts whose refresh_by is before checked_on.
Read each fact's source again through permitted access and look for its exact quote.
Record still_true with new dates from the decay classes, or changed, contradicted, retracted or source_unreadable with the evidence; never confirm a fact whose source could not be read.
Propose fold-in, and an answer-question verb for any fact that changed.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
